title: Dual PCM integrated thermoelectric generator for harvesting energy from ambient temperature variations
content:

Swathi Krishna Subhash, Jesvin Jose, Peter Woias, Uwe Pelz
A novel dual-PCM thermoelectric generator that exploits mismatched phase-change kinetics to internally generate a temperature gradient, enabling sustained electrical energy harvesting from ambient temperature variations like day–night cycles.
